concepts.def: Distance from nucleus to outer shell
Inner electrons shield outer from nucleus
Increases down: easier to lose e-
Decreases down: harder to gain e-

walkthroughs.body_html:
Down Group 1: more shells -> outer e- further from nucleus.

More shielding -> weaker attraction -> outer e- lost more easily.

So reactivity increases down Group 1.

Down Group 7: incoming e- enters a shell further from nucleus.

Weaker attraction + more shielding -> harder to gain e-.

Reactivity decreases down Group 7.

F-F bond energy is anomalous (low) due to lone pair repulsion.

Boiling points of halogens increase down: bigger molecules, stronger intermolecular forces.
